correctness.rationale: For polar symmetric edge polytope of K_{2,m} in dual root lattice with one potential fixed to zero, each t in [-2n,2n] admits (2n+1-|t|)^m integer potentials, proving L_m(n)=(2n+1)^m+2 sum_{r=1}^{2n}r^m including n=0. Incidence total unimodularity gives integral reflexive polar. Faulhaber/Bernoulli at 1 yields c_{m,j}=2^j binom(m,j)[1+2B_{m+1-j}/(m+1-j)] for 1<=j<=m, and c_{m,m+1}=2^{m+2}/(m+1), with exact inverse change-of-basis mu_{m,i}=sum_{j<=i}(-1)^{i-j}binom(m+1-j,i-j)c_{m,j}. Separately implemented exact-rational Newton interpolation from the potential counts reproduced the c_j for every m=1..20 and each required magic sign: all coefficients strictly positive m<=8, middle negative for each 9..19; ordinary coefficients positive m<=19. For EVERY m>=20, c_{m,m-19}=2^{m-19}binom(m,m-19)(1-174611/3300)<0 via B20=-174611/330, so no extrapolation from finite cases occurs. Magic basis nonnegative coefficient implies nonnegative monomial coefficients, proving complete all-m if-and-only-if. Check boundary m=1,8,9,19,20 explicitly.

value.rationale: Magic positivity of reflexive lattice polytopes is a natural strengthening of Ehrhart positivity linked to numerator real-rootedness. The family K_{2,m} appears in an actual published finite table; the precise threshold m=8 and the gap 9..19 where monomial positivity survives but magic positivity fails close a motivated classification for ALL dimensions. Complete exact finite sign checks plus a Bernoulli-index universal obstruction explain the phase boundary. Known low-m table values and the ordinary Bernoulli obstruction are credited; this is valuable as a natural complete classification, not as a new general sign paradigm.
